headline: Top-line recovery sustains; persistent cost inflation impacts margins

highlights: We note: (1) Elica sustained healthy revenue growth, even as the company continued to strengthen its premium portfolio through new product launches.
(2) Margins, however, were under pressure because of elevated commodity costs, INR depreciation, and BEE-transition related costs.
Gross/EBITDA/PAT margins contracted 435bps/138bps/57bps YoY, impacted by higher RM inflation, increased freight costs, as well as INR depreciation.
We note that the price increases implemented during the quarter were not sufficient to offset the inflationary pressures, hurting margins further.
valuation: Maintain REDUCE with a DCF-based revised TP of INR 758 (earlier: 730), implying target P/E at 22x FY28E EPS.
We maintain our REDUCE rating on the stock with a DCF- based revised TP of INR 758 (earlier: 730), implying target P/E at 22x FY28E EPS.
Key upside risks: A steep decline in competitive pressures and input prices.
